basic_info.description: Rare opportunity as this is one of the largest two bedroom and two bathroom floor plans in the building and the only residence with a private exclusive-use outdoor patio directly off the home.  Located in the heart of the highly-sought after Japantown and Lower Pacific Heights, this modern home features floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a peaceful courtyard that provides ample natural sunlight and has an open-floor layout ideal for entertaining and comfortable at-home living. The highly functional kitchen has granite countertops, breakfast bar, stainless-steel appliances featuring gas-cooktop stove and built-in microwave. Two generous sized bedrooms boast soaring high ceilings and walk-in closets with custom built-ins. Other highlights include wood floors, gas burning fireplace, in-unit washer/dryer and an oversized private storage room. Built in 2005, this well-constructed secure elevator building has an inviting lobby and two car garage parking. Relax on the shared rooftop deck offering panoramic views, great for unwinding and enjoying the outdoors. Conveniently located near public transit, only one block from the vibrant Fillmore Street and with a Walkscore of 99, this Lower Pacific Heights home is ideal for those seeking the perfect blend of comfort, style and convenience.
